description: This file defines the 'GenericNoSuchEntityException' class, which is a specific exception class in the OFBiz framework used to indicate that a requested entity was not found.

classes.name: GenericNoSuchEntityException
classes.description: An exception class indicating the absence of a requested entity in the system, extending GenericEntityException.
